use_case_1_reference_game_data_paths: reference GAME_JSONS and FULLPRESS_GAME_JSONS constants to locate all game data or full-press-only game JSON files
use_case_2_reference_pseudo_order_annota: reference PSEUDO_ORDER_SINGLEVIEW_SINGLETURN_DIR to access single-view single-turn pseudo order annotations for a given data version
use_case_3_reference_generated_messages_: reference GENERATED_MESSAGES_DIRS dictionary to look up paths for model-generated message datasets by sampling strategy key
use_case_4_reference_validation_test_ids: reference VALID_GAME_IDS and TEST_ID_PATH to identify which game IDs belong to the validation or test sets
use_case_5_reference_discriminator_data_: reference DISCRIMINATOR_VALID_DATA_ROOT and DISCRIMINATOR_VALID_TEST_DATA to locate discriminator teacher validation data
